jdbcSourceFields.dialectHelp: The flavor of SQL Provisa writes for this source. It need not match the driver: choose the one closest to the database, or ANSI.
jdbcSourceFields.jdbcDriverJarHint: The driver's jar file, uploaded from your machine. Self-hosted installs only.
jdbcSourceFields.fileHint: The database file, written {files}/… for one in the organization's files area.
jdbcSourceFields.jdbcUrlHint: The driver's jdbc: URL. Give no password in it.
